name: moment-replays
description: Names and sorts replay clips by game, with sounds, short clips, marks, Game/Desktop auto scenes and clip info for Moment Player.
long_description: Saves replay-buffer clips into a folder per game with readable names, plays a sound when a clip is saved, cuts short clips, marks moments, switches Game and Desktop scenes by itself and stores clip info (game, timeline, marks, key presses) inside each MP4 for Moment Player.
